observations: Photo 0 shows a car engine bay/engine assembly on the ground with visible pulleys, belts, hoses, and wiring harness.
No readable plate/label/engine code is visible in the photo.
No clear brand/model text is readable on the engine in the photo.
No evidence of mileage, compression test, or running condition is shown.

claims.claim: Toyota camry Engine 5x old model direct with guarantee
claims.evidence: Photo 0 does not show any readable Toyota/Camry identification, engine code, or age/mileage indicator; no guarantee document is shown.

risks.risk: Engine may not be a Toyota Camry (wrong vehicle/engine family) or wrong engine variant; photo doesn’t show engine code/label.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the engine identification plate/engine code (stamped code) and the full engine bay label, plus the VIN/engine code match from the donor car paperwork.
risks.if_unproven: Price as an unidentified used engine (worst case: not confirmed compatible), with no guarantee assumed.

risks.risk: “Works” status is unknown; photo only shows parts, not a start/run test.
risks.proof: Video of the engine cranking and running (cold start if possible), showing stable idle and no abnormal smoke/noise, plus a short clip of revving.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven working (worst case: needs overhaul/unknown condition).

risks.risk: “5x old model” and mileage/age are not verifiable from the photo.
risks.proof: Donor car year/mileage proof (receipt/inspection sheet) or engine code lookup that ties to year, shown clearly.
risks.if_unproven: Price as older/unknown age with higher overhaul risk.

risks.risk: “Direct with guarantee” may be unenforceable or not documented.
risks.proof: A written guarantee/return terms document (or WhatsApp message screenshot) showing duration and what is covered, plus contact details of the guarantor.

proof_requests: Send a close-up photo of the engine code/identification plate (stamped code) and any Toyota label—make sure it’s readable.
Send a video of the engine cranking and running (start + idle + brief rev), ideally showing no overheating and no abnormal smoke.
Send donor details: year/mileage and any receipt/inspection sheet that matches the engine code.
Send the guarantee terms in writing (duration, coverage, return/refund conditions).
response.reason: The photo shows an engine assembly but provides no readable engine code or Toyota/Camry identification, and there’s no proof it runs or that the guarantee is real. Without those, a worst-case price can’t be confidently set.
